name: inventory-software-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Smart Inventory Management System

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && (ls venv/bin/python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./venv/bin/python3 main.py || python3 main.py)
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:migrate: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/migration/add_vision_tracking_tables.py } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 scripts/migration/add_vision_tracking_tables.py } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pyPath = (Get-Command python).Source; if ($pyPath -like '*WindowsApps*') { Write-Error 'Detected Windows Store python stub. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }; python scripts/migration/add_vision_tracking_tables.py } else { Write-Error 'Python not found. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }"
scripts.db:seed: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/seed/seed_drawers.py } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 scripts/seed/seed_drawers.py } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pyPath = (Get-Command python).Source; if ($pyPath -like '*WindowsApps*') { Write-Error 'Detected Windows Store python stub. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }; python scripts/seed/seed_drawers.py } else { Write-Error 'Python not found. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }"
